title: Zero-boundary correction passes hidden validation
description: A bounded candidate corrects zero being counted as positive and generalizes to unseen cases.
objective: Correct score_items so zero is not counted as a positive value.

scripted_proposals.hypothesis: Using a strict greater-than comparison fixes the boundary.

patches.content:
def score_items(values: list[int]) -> int:
    return sum(value > 0 for value in values)

boundaries: Success does not establish large-repository repair performance.
